verses.72:15: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبࣰ ا

en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
meaning: The root حَطَبَ (ḥaṭaba) denotes firewood and gathering it. Ibn Fāris gives one core — الوقود, fuel — with figurative extensions built on it, as in one who gathers slander as one gathers sticks.
meaning_source: Derived from the classical dictionaries (chiefly Maqayis al-Lugha, Ibn Faris d.1004) held in lexicon_full/
